subject: Coordinating first demo + rotating overlap windows for GreenWave - action items
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@greenwaveenergy.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 10 Apr 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating first demo and multi-timezone cadence - availability + attendees

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the interest — excited to walk GreenWave through Redwood. To make this productive we want the right people on the call (AE + SE + customer cloud engineer + procurement + security). Could you confirm who from your side will attend? In the meantime I put together three overlap windows that try to cover US / EU / APAC participants:

- Option A: 2028-04-19 16:00 UTC (09:00 PDT / 17:00 CET / 01:00 JST next day) — favors US morning + EU afternoon
- Option B: 2028-04-20 12:00 UTC (05:00 PDT / 13:00 CET / 21:00 JST) — early US + late APAC
- Option C: 2028-04-21 22:00 UTC (15:00 PDT / 00:00 CET next day / 07:00 JST) — late EU overlap for APAC morning

Suggested format: 45 minute product/demo run (no customer data) + 15 minutes Q&A + 10 minute procurement/security touchpoint at the end if needed.

Attachments: SOW_v0.9.pdf (stub) with scope & tentative pricing.

If none of these match, please propose 2 windows (with timezone) that work for engineering + security + procurement at GreenWave and we’ll adapt. Also noting we can run a rotating schedule for follow-up deep dives so the timing alternates each week to be fair across regions — Marcus, Priyom: does that sound OK operationally?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
(attachment: SOW_v0.9.pdf)

From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@greenwaveenergy.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@greenwaveenergy.com>, procurement@greenwaveenergy.com, security@greenwaveenergy.com
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:40:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Coordinating first demo and multi-timezone cadence - availability + attendees

Hi Mina —

Thanks — quick update from GreenWave:

- Attendees: Me (Cloud Eng), Samir (Lead SWE), procurement@ for PO lead, security@ for compliance review.
- Preference: Option A (2028-04-19 16:00 UTC) works best for engineering. Option B is tight for Samir because of an all-hands.
- Procurement note: they need the SOW + a short pricing worksheet to start internal review. PO timeline ~3-4 weeks.

Looping in procurement and security for any scheduling constraints. If procurement needs a CET midday meeting, we can try another slot but would prefer to keep engineering-friendly Option A.

Olivia
Olivia Turner
Cloud Engineer, GreenWave Energy
olivia.turner@greenwaveenergy.com

Mina / Priyom —

Quick SE notes:
- We can demo core inference flow (hosted API + routing + cost controls) in 45 minutes if we keep it focused. If they want a private deployment deep dive we'll need 60-75 minutes.
- Run requirements: no customer data, test dataset provided by us; screen share access to Olivia + Samir for permissions.
- Proposed rotating cadence for follow-ups (so we’re fair across timezones):
  * Week 1: US-friendly slot (mornings PT / late afternoon CET)
  * Week 2: EU-friendly slot (midday CET / late night PT / morning APAC)
  * Week 3: APAC-friendly slot (early UTC evening / late CET / morning JST)

I attached a short runbook and checklist — demo-runbook.md (stub) — Marcus will lead the demo. Priyom: I’ll need your calendar for the next 6 weeks to seed the rotation.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(attachment: demo-runbook.md)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@greenwaveenergy.com>, procurement@greenwaveenergy.com, security@greenwaveenergy.com
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 10:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Coordinating first demo and multi-timezone cadence - availability + attendees

Thanks Olivia — looping in procurement and security explicitly so we can capture any gating items. Action items and asks:

- Olivia / Samir: confirm Option A (2028-04-19 16:00 UTC) or propose two alternate windows before EOD Thursday 2028-04-14.
- Procurement: can you confirm PO intake steps and any required PO template or billing contact? We included SOW_v0.9.pdf in case it helps.
- Security: please list the high-level review checklist (data retention, logging, access controls) — if you want a separate 20-minute pre-demo call we can set that up.
- Priyom / Marcus: once time is locked Priyom will send invites and Marcus will validate the runbook.

Poll + docs: https://cal.poll/greenwave-demo-options  — please add your preferred choice there (will use to finalize time). Also sending an NDA via DocuSign for signature in case procurement wants that signed before access: https://docusign.com/NDA/GW-4521

Thanks — Mina
(attachment: SOW_v0.9.pdf)

Hi Mina —

We can confirm a procurement contact for the PO process. Couple of asks before we move to the internal review:

1) Please provide a one-page pricing worksheet (line items for hosted usage + optional dedicated pricing).
2) We prefer demos scheduled around CET 14:00 for procurement participants — if Option A (16:00 UTC / 17:00 CET) remains the best choice for engineering, procurement can still join as a late attendee.

PO timeline: approx 3-4 weeks once SOW + pricing received. See attached PO_requirements.xlsx for format we need.

Regards,
GW Procurement Team
(attachment: PO_requirements.xlsx)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>

All — great alignment. Per responses we’ll lock Option A for the initial demo:

- Scheduled: 2028-04-19 16:00 UTC (calendar invite to follow) — Duration 60 minutes (45 min demo + 15 min Q&A + 10 min optional procurement/security touch).
- Rotation cadence agreed: alternating weekly windows (US-friendly -> EU-friendly -> APAC-friendly). Priyom will seed the next 6 weeks and Marcus will confirm the runbook before each session.
- Procurement: we received PO_requirements.xlsx — we’ll send a short pricing worksheet and an updated SOW by EOD Wednesday 2028-04-17.
- Security: please confirm if you need a 20-minute pre-demo sync; otherwise we’ll include a 10-minute compliance summary at the end.

Next steps: Priyom will send calendar invites and preliminary agenda. Marcus will attach the final runbook. Mina will upload the pricing worksheet and updated SOW to the HubSpot deal (link below).

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.

Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
